name: slide-smith
description: Turns raw material into a reviewed outline, a page-by-page slide spec, and a finished deck — as a runnable HTML presentation, an editable PPTX, or a PPTX with page-by-page generated visuals. Four gated steps, a stored preference library, 19 visual styles, and 14 argument methods, chosen independently.

displayDescription.en: Turns your material into an outline, a page-by-page slide spec, and a finished deck — HTML 放映页, 可编辑 PPTX, or 逐页生图 PPTX, your call. Four gated reviews, recorded judgments, 19 visual skins and 14 argument methods picked separately.
displayDescription.zh: 资料拆成大纲、逐页分镜与成片演示，HTML、PPTX、生图 PPTX 三选一，四步审核，风格可换。
